name: MSI Fan & RGB
author: kamil
description: Fan curves and Mystic Light RGB control for MSI motherboards in the Omarchy bar: temperatures, pump and system fan RPM, named fan profiles, per-fan manual speed and RGB presets.

barWidget.description: Shows CPU temperature and fan speed. Click for fan profiles, per-fan manual control and Mystic Light RGB presets.

schema.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often the widget asks msi-fanctl for temperatures and fan speeds. A status read is a handful of sysfs files, so 2-5 seconds is cheap.

schema.label: Bar label
schema.description: What to print beside the fan icon. Fan RPM shows the fastest spinning header at the moment.

schema.label: Show RGB controls
schema.description: Add the Mystic Light section to the popup. Turn it off if you manage lighting elsewhere.

schema.label: Show empty fan headers
schema.description: Show every header the Super I/O exposes, including ones with no fan attached. Otherwise only headers reporting RPM (and the CPU fan) are listed.

schema.label: OpenRGB device filter
schema.description: Substring of the OpenRGB device name to control, for example 'MSI'. Empty means the first MSI device OpenRGB finds, which is the motherboard on a single-controller system.
